s: She work in a big hospital.
fix: She works in a big hospital.
tip: He / she / it — дієслово із закінченням -s: she works.

s: My brother don't like coffee.
fix: My brother doesn't like coffee.
tip: У 3-й особі заперечення — doesn't, а не don't.

s: He doesn't likes cheese.
fix: He doesn't like cheese.
tip: Після does / doesn't дієслово без -s: he doesn't like.

s: He have a big dog.
fix: He has a big dog.
tip: He / she / it — has, а не have.

s: I am agree with you.
fix: I agree with you.
tip: Agree — дієслово, am не потрібне: I agree.

s: We was at home all evening.
fix: We were at home all evening.

s: There is many people in the park.
fix: There are many people in the park.
tip: Множина після there — there are.

s: There are a supermarket next to my house.
fix: There is a supermarket next to my house.
tip: Один предмет — there is a…

s: I have a lot of homeworks tonight.
fix: I have a lot of homework tonight.
tip: Homework незлічуване — без -s.

s: Can you give me an advice?
fix: Can you give me some advice?
tip: Advice незлічуване: some advice або a piece of advice.

s: How much apples do we need?
fix: How many apples do we need?
tip: Злічувані (apples) — how many; незлічувані — how much.

s: He is very good in football.
fix: He is very good at football.
tip: Good at — бути вправним у чомусь.

s: I'm interested on history.
fix: I'm interested in history.
tip: Interested in — цікавитися чимось.

s: She listens music every evening.
fix: She listens to music every evening.
tip: Listen to — слухати щось; без to не можна.

s: He's afraid from dogs.
fix: He's afraid of dogs.
tip: Afraid of — боятися чогось.

s: She is a engineer.
fix: She is an engineer.
tip: Перед голосним звуком — an: an engineer.

s: He is doctor.
fix: He is a doctor.
tip: Професія в однині — з артиклем: he is a doctor.

s: Can you close door, please?
fix: Can you close the door, please?
tip: Конкретні двері, які обоє бачите, — the door.

s: I love the nature.
fix: I love nature.
tip: Nature, life, music загалом — без the.

s: I was born at 1995.
fix: I was born in 1995.
tip: Рік, місяць — in: in 1995, in May.

s: See you in Monday!
fix: See you on Monday!
tip: Дні тижня й дати — on: on Monday.

s: I usually get up in 7 o'clock.
fix: I usually get up at 7 o'clock.
tip: Точний час — at: at 7 o'clock.

s: I'm going to home now.
fix: I'm going home now.
tip: Go home — без to.

s: We are going in holiday next week.
fix: We are going on holiday next week.
tip: Go on holiday — їхати у відпустку.

s: Where you live now?
fix: Where do you live now?
tip: У питанні потрібне допоміжне do / does: where do you live?

s: Do she live near you?
fix: Does she live near you?
tip: З he / she / it у питанні — does.

s: He can to swim very well.
fix: He can swim very well.
tip: Після can, must, should — дієслово без to.

s: I didn't went to work yesterday.
fix: I didn't go to work yesterday.
tip: Після did / didn't — початкова форма: didn't go.

s: Did you saw the match?
fix: Did you see the match?
tip: Минулий час уже в did, тож дієслово — see.

s: Yesterday I buyed a new jacket.
fix: Yesterday I bought a new jacket.
tip: Buy — bought — bought.

s: She has two childs.
fix: She has two children.
tip: Child — children: множина неправильна.

s: My sister is more taller than me.
fix: My sister is taller than me.
tip: Або -er, або more — не разом: taller.

s: My phone is cheaper that yours.
fix: My phone is cheaper than yours.
tip: Порівняння — than: cheaper than.

s: Look! It snowing.
fix: Look! It's snowing.
tip: Тривалий час — be + -ing: it's snowing.

s: Listen! The baby crying.
fix: Listen! The baby is crying.
tip: Без is не буде Present Continuous: the baby is crying.

s: I can't find my keys. Have you seen it?
fix: I can't find my keys. Have you seen them?
tip: Keys — множина, тож them.

s: This is mine book.
fix: This is my book.
tip: Перед іменником — my; mine — без іменника: it's mine.

s: I very like this song.
fix: I really like this song.
tip: Very не стоїть перед дієсловом: I really like / I like it very much.

s: How do you call this in English?
fix: What do you call this in English?
tip: Калька з «як це називається» — правильно What do you call…?

s: I feel myself tired today.
fix: I feel tired today.
tip: Калька з «почуваюся»: I feel tired — без myself.

s: We usually have breakfast at 8 o'clock.
fix: We usually have breakfast at 8 o'clock.
tip: Усе правильно: точний час — at.

s: She goes to the gym twice a week.
fix: She goes to the gym twice a week.
tip: Усе правильно: she goes — із закінченням -es.

s: I bought an umbrella yesterday.
fix: I bought an umbrella yesterday.
tip: Усе правильно: перед голосним звуком — an.

s: How many eggs do we need?
fix: How many eggs do we need?
tip: Усе правильно: eggs злічувані — how many.

s: Where did you go last weekend?
fix: Where did you go last weekend?
tip: Усе правильно: did + go, а не did + went.

s: My flat is smaller than yours.
fix: My flat is smaller than yours.
tip: Усе правильно: короткий прикметник + -er + than.

s: Could you give me some advice?
fix: Could you give me some advice?
tip: Усе правильно: advice незлічуване — some advice.

s: Where were you born?
fix: Where were you born?
tip: Усе правильно: were you born — без did.

s: We have met in 2019.
fix: We met in 2019.
tip: Є точний час у минулому — Past Simple: we met in 2019.

s: She has left an hour ago.
fix: She left an hour ago.
tip: З ago — лише Past Simple: she left an hour ago.

s: I've worked here since five years.
fix: I've worked here for five years.
tip: For + тривалість (five years), since + початок (2020).

s: We have lived in this flat for 2015.
fix: We have lived in this flat since 2015.
tip: Since + момент початку: since 2015.

s: We've been friends for we were kids.
fix: We've been friends since we were kids.
tip: Since + подія, з якої почалося: since we were kids.

s: I haven't seen him since a long time.
fix: I haven't seen him for a long time.
tip: A long time — це тривалість, тож for.

s: If I will have time, I'll call you.
fix: If I have time, I'll call you.
tip: Після if про майбутнє — теперішній час: if I have time.

s: I'll call you when I will get home.
fix: I'll call you when I get home.
tip: Після when, as soon as — без will: when I get home.

s: I'm looking forward to see you.
fix: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
tip: Look forward to + -ing: to seeing you.

s: Do you mind open the window?
fix: Do you mind opening the window?
tip: Mind + -ing: do you mind opening…?

s: I avoid drive at night.
fix: I avoid driving at night.
tip: Avoid + -ing: avoid driving.

s: I'm used to get up early.
fix: I'm used to getting up early.
tip: Be used to + -ing — мати звичку: used to getting up.

s: We discussed about the plan.
fix: We discussed the plan.
tip: Discuss щось — без about.

s: It depends of the weather.
fix: It depends on the weather.
tip: Depend on — залежати від.

s: I'm married with a teacher.
fix: I'm married to a teacher.
tip: Married to — у шлюбі з кимось.

s: Can you make me a favour?
fix: Can you do me a favour?
tip: Do somebody a favour — зробити послугу.

s: I need to do a decision today.
fix: I need to make a decision today.
tip: Make a decision — ухвалити рішення.

s: Can I make a question?
fix: Can I ask a question?
tip: Питання ставлять — ask a question.

s: I usually go to work with bus.
fix: I usually go to work by bus.
tip: Транспорт — by без артикля: by bus, by car; пішки — on foot.

s: The news are really good today.
fix: The news is really good today.
tip: News — однина, хоч і з -s: the news is.

s: Everybody know about it.
fix: Everybody knows about it.
tip: Everybody — однина: everybody knows.

s: Each of the students have a laptop.
fix: Each of the students has a laptop.
tip: Each of — однина: each of them has.

s: Your hair look great today.
fix: Your hair looks great today.
tip: Hair — незлічуване, однина: your hair looks.

s: What time does the film starts?
fix: What time does the film start?
tip: Після does — дієслово без -s: does it start?

s: What did she said?
fix: What did she say?
tip: Після did — початкова форма: did she say?

s: I must to finish this report tonight.
fix: I must finish this report tonight.
tip: Must + дієслово без to.

s: You should to try this cake.
fix: You should try this cake.
tip: Should + дієслово без to.

s: Let him to finish his sentence.
fix: Let him finish his sentence.
tip: Let somebody do — без to.

s: He said me that he was tired.
fix: He told me that he was tired.
tip: Tell somebody, але say something: he told me.

s: The window was broke by the wind.
fix: The window was broken by the wind.
tip: Пасив — be + третя форма: was broken.

s: There isn't some milk in the fridge.
fix: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
tip: У запереченні — any: there isn't any milk.

s: I don't know nothing about it.
fix: I don't know anything about it.
tip: Одне заперечення на речення: don't know anything.

s: This is the most cheapest option.
fix: This is the cheapest option.
tip: Або -est, або most — не разом: the cheapest.

s: Every morning my parents goes for a walk.
fix: Every morning my parents go for a walk.
tip: Parents — множина, тож go без -es.

s: My friend gave me an useful tip.
fix: My friend gave me a useful tip.
tip: Useful починається зі звука [j] — тож a useful.

s: It's a good weather today.
fix: It's good weather today.
tip: Weather незлічуване — без a.

s: She is boring at work, so she's looking for a new job.
fix: She is bored at work, so she's looking for a new job.
tip: Bored — мені нудно; boring — щось нудне.

s: The film was so bored that I fell asleep.
fix: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
tip: Фільм нудний — boring; людині нудно — bored.

s: Learning English is very interested.
fix: Learning English is very interesting.
tip: Щось цікаве — interesting; мені цікаво — I'm interested.

s: Could you borrow me your pen?
fix: Could you lend me your pen?
tip: Lend — дати в позику; borrow — взяти в позику.

s: She has wrote three books.
fix: She has written three books.
tip: Write — wrote — written; після has — третя форма.

s: When I arrived, they were have dinner.
fix: When I arrived, they were having dinner.
tip: Тривалий час — were + -ing: were having.

s: Have you ever been to Scotland?
fix: Have you ever been to Scotland?
tip: Усе правильно: досвід без часу — Present Perfect.

s: How long have you lived here?
fix: How long have you lived here?
tip: Усе правильно: тривалість до тепер — Present Perfect.

s: Who told you about the party?
fix: Who told you about the party?
tip: Усе правильно: питання до підмета — без did.

s: He has been working here for six months.
fix: He has been working here for six months.
tip: Усе правильно: for + тривалість.

s: She told me that she was tired.
fix: She told me that she was tired.
tip: Усе правильно: told me — tell з особою.

s: What are you doing tonight?
fix: What are you doing tonight?
tip: Усе правильно: домовленість — Present Continuous.

s: It was raining when we left the house.
fix: It was raining when we left the house.
tip: Усе правильно: тло — was raining, подія — left.

s: She has already done her homework.
fix: She has already done her homework.
tip: Усе правильно: already — Present Perfect.

s: I'll be back in ten minutes.
fix: I'll be back in ten minutes.
tip: Усе правильно: in ten minutes — через десять хвилин.

s: If I had more time, I will learn Italian.
fix: If I had more time, I would learn Italian.
tip: Друга умовна: if + past, would + дієслово.

s: If she had left earlier, she would have catch the train.
fix: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
tip: Would have + третя форма: would have caught.

s: I wish I have more free time.
fix: I wish I had more free time.
tip: Wish про теперішнє — минула форма: I wish I had.

s: I wish I can speak Japanese.
fix: I wish I could speak Japanese.
tip: Wish + could: I wish I could.

s: He told that he was busy.
fix: He said that he was busy.
tip: Tell потребує особи (told me); без неї — said.

s: The house was build in 1990.
fix: The house was built in 1990.
tip: Пасив — be + третя форма: was built.

s: They had their roof repair last month.
fix: They had their roof repaired last month.
tip: Have something done: had their roof repaired.

s: There's no point in argue about it.
fix: There's no point in arguing about it.
tip: Після прийменника — -ing: no point in arguing.

s: She insisted on pay for dinner.
fix: She insisted on paying for dinner.
tip: Insist on + -ing: insisted on paying.

s: I'd rather to stay at home tonight.
fix: I'd rather stay at home tonight.
tip: Would rather + дієслово без to.

s: You'd better to take an umbrella.
fix: You'd better take an umbrella.
tip: Had better + дієслово без to.

s: She must have forget her keys.
fix: She must have forgotten her keys.
tip: Must have + третя форма: must have forgotten.

s: You needn't to worry about it.
fix: You needn't worry about it.
tip: Needn't — модальне: без to.

s: He made me to wait for an hour.
fix: He made me wait for an hour.
tip: Make somebody do — без to (але в пасиві: was made to).

s: Despite of the rain, we went for a walk.
fix: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
tip: Despite — без of; in spite of — з of.

s: Although the rain, we went out.
fix: Despite the rain, we went out.
tip: Although + речення; despite + іменник.

s: Even I tried hard, I couldn't open it.
fix: Even though I tried hard, I couldn't open it.
tip: «Хоча» — even though або although, не просто even.

s: The lecture was cancelled because of the professor was ill.
fix: The lecture was cancelled because the professor was ill.
tip: Because + речення; because of + іменник.

s: The police is investigating the case.
fix: The police are investigating the case.
tip: Police — завжди множина: the police are.

s: The number of tourists have grown.
fix: The number of tourists has grown.
tip: The number of — однина: has grown.

s: A number of people has complained.
fix: A number of people have complained.
tip: A number of («багато») — множина: have complained.

s: Few people knows the answer.
fix: Few people know the answer.
tip: People — множина: people know.

s: I have a lot of informations about it.
fix: I have a lot of information about it.
tip: Information незлічуване — без -s.

s: We need more equipments for the office.
fix: We need more equipment for the office.
tip: Equipment незлічуване — без -s.

s: The furniture are very old.
fix: The furniture is very old.
tip: Furniture незлічуване — однина: is.

s: She's the person which helped me.
fix: She's the person who helped me.
tip: Про людей — who; which — про речі.

s: This is the town where I was born in.
fix: This is the town where I was born.
tip: Where вже означає «у якому» — in зайве.

s: She has worked here since she has finished university.
fix: She has worked here since she finished university.
tip: Після since — подія в минулому: since she finished.

s: I'll have finished the report until Friday.
fix: I'll have finished the report by Friday.
tip: Крайній строк — by Friday; until — дія триває до.

s: If you'd told me, I'd have came.
fix: If you'd told me, I'd have come.
tip: Come — came — come; після have — come.

s: He's responsible of marketing.
fix: He's responsible for marketing.
tip: Responsible for — відповідальний за.

s: I'm keen in photography.
fix: I'm keen on photography.
tip: Keen on — захоплюватися чимось.

s: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
fix: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
tip: Усе правильно: look forward to + -ing.

s: Had I known about the problem, I'd have called you.
fix: Had I known about the problem, I'd have called you.
tip: Усе правильно: інверсія замість if I had known.

s: Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
fix: Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
tip: Усе правильно: після hardly — інверсія had we.

s: We were made to wait for an hour.
fix: We were made to wait for an hour.
tip: Усе правильно: у пасиві make — з to.

s: I'm used to living in a big city.
fix: I'm used to living in a big city.
tip: Усе правильно: be used to + -ing.

s: He apologised for being late.
fix: He apologised for being late.
tip: Усе правильно: apologise for + -ing.

s: It's the first time I've been here.
fix: It's the first time I've been here.
tip: Усе правильно: it's the first time + Present Perfect.

s: She suggested that we take a taxi.
fix: She suggested that we take a taxi.
tip: Усе правильно: suggest that we take або suggest taking.

s: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
fix: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
tip: Усе правильно: пасив has been postponed.
